title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Invites America to Celebrate National Bowling Day
summary: Guests Can Celebrate at Lucky Strike, AMF and Bowlero Locations Nationwide with 50% Off Unlimited Bowling on Saturday, August 8 Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier owner-operators of location-based entertainment destinations, is inviting families, friends and bowling fans to celebrate National Bowling Day on Saturday, August 8, with 50% off Unlimited Bowling and shoe rental from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. at participating Lucky Strike, AMF and Bowlero locations nationwide. Guests can also receive 20% off lane reservations and events booked August 3–9 using promo code BOWL for visits through August 31. In celebration of National Bowling Day, Lucky Strike Entertainment is bringing its Bowling Forever campaign to life through new digital activations and larger-than-life creative moments, including a Times Square billboard takeover.
